metadata.title: Wiki Directory Structure and Article Format

story.iWant: the wiki directory structure created in each project workspace with a defined article format
story.soThat: compiled knowledge has a consistent, organized home following the Karpathy wiki pattern

task.title: Create wiki initialization script init-wiki.sh
task.subtask: Accept two arguments: projectId (e.g., spyhunter) and workingDir (e.g., /home/ubuntu/projects/spyhunter)
Create all phase directories under ${workingDir}/knowledge/: code/, decisions/, requirements/, discovery/, planning/, solutioning/, qa/, system/, archive/
Use mkdir -p to ensure idempotency — no errors if directories already exist
Create files only if they do not already exist (use -f check before writing)

task.title: Initialize index.md with catalog structure
task.subtask: Include empty sections for each phase: Discovery, Planning, Solutioning, Implementation, QA, Release, Support, System
Each section has a placeholder for article listings (table or list format)

task.title: Initialize log.md with creation entry
task.subtask: Append creation entry with timestamp: | {date} | Wiki initialized for {projectId} | init-wiki.sh |

task.title: Create system articles
task.subtask: Create ${workingDir}/knowledge/system/dependency-map.md with frontmatter (type: system, phase: system, status: active)

task.title: Validate initialization
task.subtask: Run init-wiki.sh with a test project
Verify all directories exist via find
Run script again on same project — verify no content is overwritten

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: The following directory structure is created under /home/ubuntu/projects/{name}/knowledge/: index.md, log.md, code/, decisions/, requirements/, discovery/, planning/, solutioning/, qa/, system/ (with pre-created files: dependency-map.md, deployment-manifest.md, debt-registry.md, pending-work.md), archive/
index.md is initialized with the project name and empty catalog structure
log.md is initialized with a creation entry
The initialization script takes projectId and workingDir as arguments
The script is idempotent — running it on an existing project does not overwrite existing content

doc.title: Mycelium-Labs Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Project workspace layout: /home/ubuntu/projects/{name}/ with knowledge/ directory containing index.md, log.md, phase directories (code/, decisions/, requirements/, discovery/, planning/, solutioning/, qa/, system/, archive/), and .mycelium/ metadata directory with compile-state.json and embeddings-queue.json

doc.title: Mycelium-Labs Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Article format with YAML frontmatter (title, type, phase, status, maturity, created, updated, createdByEpic, createdByStory, lastMutatedByStory, tags). File naming: knowledge/{phase}/{slug}.md with -- for path separators. Article body sections: Purpose, Key Exports, Dependencies, Dependents, Signals, Missing Signals, Notes. Article types by phase table.

doc.title: Mycelium-Labs Architecture Document
doc.snippet: D1: Wiki markdown as persistence (Karpathy pattern), human-readable, LLM-maintainable. D7: Phase-organized directories with typed articles. D9: Wiki as source of truth, Memgraph rebuilt from wiki.

file.reason: Reference for shell script structure, idempotency patterns (mkdir -p, file existence checks), and setup script conventions used in the project
Defines project workspace path convention (ec2Path: /home/ubuntu/projects/{name}) that init-wiki.sh must respect

package.name: bash
package.reason: Shell script — no additional dependencies required

constraints.constraint: No dependency on Story MY-1.1 — this story can run in parallel with Memgraph setup
Script must be idempotent — mkdir -p for directories, -f existence checks before writing files
Shell script (not Node.js) — simpler, no dependencies, faster execution
All system articles must include proper YAML frontmatter (type: system, phase: system, status: active)
File naming convention: slug uses -- for path separators in code files (e.g., src--components--auth.tsx.md)
The /home/ubuntu/scripts/ directory should already exist from Story 1.1, but the script should create it if missing
Article frontmatter schema must match exactly what Memgraph nodes expect (Story 1.2) — same property names

interface.name: init-wiki.sh CLI
interface.details: Arguments: $1=projectId (e.g., spyhunter), $2=workingDir (e.g., /home/ubuntu/projects/spyhunter). Creates knowledge/ directory tree and .mycelium/ metadata under workingDir.

interface.name: Article Frontmatter Schema
interface.details: Required fields: title, type, phase, status, maturity, created, updated, createdByEpic, createdByStory, lastMutatedByStory, tags. Status values: active, superseded, flagged, pruned.

standards.standard: Manual validation via script execution — run init-wiki.sh on a test project and verify directory tree, file contents, and idempotency
File existence checks — verify all 9 phase directories, index.md, log.md, 4 system articles, and 2 .mycelium files
Idempotency test — run script twice on same project, verify no content overwritten

locations.location: daemon/scripts/init-wiki.sh (the script itself, tested by execution)

ideas.idea: Run init-wiki.sh with test projectId, then use find to list all created directories and files; verify against expected structure
Check index.md contains the project name header and all 8 phase sections (Discovery through System)
Check log.md contains a creation entry with date and projectId
Parse .mycelium/compile-state.json with jq and verify it equals {}
Parse .mycelium/embeddings-queue.json with jq and verify it equals []
Run init-wiki.sh without arguments — verify usage help is printed
Write custom content to index.md, run init-wiki.sh again, verify custom content is preserved
